concerns.text: FR-004 requires generating 'cumulative prime density weighted by partition weight (defined as sum_{p <= n} 1/p)' as a predictor. Task T016a lists features: pi(n), 1/ln(n), distance_to_nearest_prime, prime_gap_size, sin_log_n, cos_log_n. The specific feature 'cumulative prime density weighted by partition weight' (sum 1/p) is missing from the task description and implementation plan.

SC-002 and Plan.md 'Complexity Tracking' require 'time-series cross-validation (blocking)' to handle autocorrelated residuals. Task T024 explicitly implements 'scikit-learn's KFold' (standard random partitioning). There is no task to implement the required time-series/blocked CV logic, creating a gap between the success criterion and the implementation plan.

FR-002 mandates explicit validation of Meinardus' theorem conditions (pole structure of prime zeta function) and a fallback to truncated Dirichlet series if conditions are not met. Tasks T005 and T041 focus on implementing the asymptotic formula and documentation, but no task exists to implement the 'validate_meinardus.py' logic or the fallback mechanism required by the spec.

FR-001 and Plan.md require handling n up to 50,000. Task T016a requires calculating 'prime_gap_size' for n near the upper bound, which necessitates access to the 'next prime' (potentially > 50,000). Task T004 limits the sieve to exactly 50,000. There is no task to extend the sieve or implement an on-the-fly prime generation fallback for the gap calculation at the boundary.

Task T038 requires creating 'docs/residual_error_term_report.md' to satisfy Constitution Principle VI, but the task description is vague ('document the analysis') and does not specify the required content (e.,g., explicit reporting of the residual error term for the finite n range, methodology for exact partition values) to ensure the 'measurable' aspect of the constitution check is met.
